scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && pnpm dev" "cd frontend && pnpm dev"
scripts.install-all: pnpm install && cd backend && pnpm install && cd ../frontend && pnpm install
scripts.build: cd backend && pnpm build && cd ../frontend && pnpm build
scripts.start: concurrently "cd backend && pnpm start" "cd frontend && pnpm start"
